Question: Two swimmers, at opposite ends of a \(90\)-foot pool, start to swim the length of the pool, one at the rate of \(3\) feet per second, the other at \(2\) feet per second. They swim back and forth for \(12\) minutes. Allowing no loss of time at the turns, find the number of times they pass each other.
